instructions:
1. Sit at the lat pulldown machine with your feet flat on the floor and knees secured under the pads.
2. Grasp the close-grip handle with palms facing each other and arms fully extended overhead.
3. Pull the handle down toward your upper chest, driving your elbows down and back.
4. Squeeze your back at the bottom, then slowly let the handle rise until your arms are fully extended.
5. Repeat.
tips:
1. Drive with your elbows, not your hands, to keep tension on the lats.
2. Keep your chest up and shoulders down to avoid rounding your back.
3. Exhale as you pull down, inhale as you return.
4. Move slowly and avoid using momentum or leaning back excessively.
name: Cable close grip front lat pulldown

instructions:
1. Attach a straight bar to a low pulley and stand facing away with the cable between your legs.
2. Hold the bar with an overhand grip, arms extended down in front of your thighs.
3. Stand upright with your core engaged and a slight bend in your elbows.
4. Raise the bar in front of you to shoulder height.
5. Slowly lower the bar back to the starting position.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your torso still and avoid swinging or using momentum.
2. Exhale as you raise the bar, inhale as you lower it.
3. Keep your shoulders down, not shrugged toward your ears.
4. Stop at shoulder height to keep tension on the front delts.
name: Cable front raises straight bar

instructions:
1. Stand in the middle of a cable machine with a handle attached to each low pulley.
2. Hold the left handle in your right hand and the right handle in your left hand, cables crossing in front.
3. Stand upright with your arms extended and a slight bend in your elbows.
4. Raise the handles out to your sides until your arms are parallel to the floor.
5. Slowly lower the handles back to the starting position.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Lead with your elbows and keep your wrists neutral.
2. Exhale as you raise the handles, inhale as you lower them.
3. Avoid swinging or using momentum.
4. Keep your traps relaxed to isolate the side delts.
name: Cable lateral raises

instructions:
1. Attach a single handle to a low pulley and hold it in your outside hand.
2. Grip the machine with your inside hand and lean away until your arm hangs across your body.
3. Position your feet together with a stable stance.
4. Raise the handle out to the side until your arm is parallel to the floor.
5. Slowly lower the handle back to the starting position, then switch sides.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Lean away from the machine to load the side delt through a longer range.
2. Lead with your elbow and keep a slight bend throughout.
3. Exhale as you raise the handle, inhale as you lower it.
4. Move slowly and avoid swinging from the hips.
name: Cable leaning lateral raise

instructions:
1. Set both pulleys to the lowest position and grasp a handle in each hand with palms facing forward.
2. Step forward into a staggered stance with arms extended down and out to your sides.
3. Keep a slight bend in your elbows and your chest up.
4. Bring the handles up and together in front of your body in a wide arc, palms turning up.
5. Slowly return the handles to the starting position with control.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Squeeze your chest as you bring the handles together at the top.
2. Keep the bend in your elbows fixed; do not turn it into a press.
3. Exhale as you bring the handles together, inhale as you return.
4. Keep your shoulders retracted to protect the shoulder joint.
name: Cable low fly
